title: Matter is admitted, not given: existence is a permission crossing a threshold

statements.text: Kolesnikov: matter is not created but admitted. A phase energy function $\phi_e(x, t)$ that meets or exceeds a threshold $\varepsilon$ sets a permission function to $+1$, and only then does matter manifest. Antimatter is inverse permission, $-1$.

sources.quote: We do not create matter — we allow it to be. Matter is not given; it is admitted.
If it meets or exceeds the threshold ε, the system grants permission
